title: Create Research Feed Intelligence service
acceptance_criteria: Pure function: detect_trends(feed_runs: list[dict]) -> dict with trending_topics, velocity, peak_periods
Pure function: flag_anomalies(feed_runs: list[dict]) -> list[dict] with anomaly_type, severity, description
Pure function: compute_feed_intelligence(feed_manager, feed_id) -> dict combining trends + anomalies
Uses existing FeedRun data structures from research_feeds.py
All functions < 50 lines, no side effects
